name: docx
headline: docx: Document Creation
short_description: The docx skill for Claude Code automates the creation and manipulation of DOCX files, enabling users to generate documents programmatically. This skill significantly reduces manual document handling, saving time and increasing productivity.
author: anthropics

sections.overview:
The docx skill for Claude Code is designed to automate the creation and manipulation of DOCX files, allowing users to generate and modify documents programmatically. By leveraging this skill, developers can seamlessly integrate document handling into their applications, making it easier to produce reports, letters, and other text-based files without manual intervention. This automation not only enhances efficiency but also minimizes the risk of human error in document preparation. Key benefits of the docx skill include significant time savings and improved workflow efficiency. Instead of spending hours formatting and updating documents manually, users can execute commands that generate professional-quality documents in seconds. This is particularly valuable for teams that require consistent document formats or need to produce large volumes of paperwork quickly. The skill's straightforward integration into existing workflows makes it an essential tool for enhancing productivity. The docx skill is perfect for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who frequently work with document generation and management. It is particularly useful for those in industries such as legal, finance, and education, where document accuracy and consistency are paramount. Practical use cases include generating client contracts, creating automated reports from databases, and producing personalized letters or invoices based on user input. Implementation of the docx skill is relatively straightforward, requiring basic programming knowledge to set up. As businesses increasingly adopt AI-first workflows, integrating the docx skill can streamline document-related tasks, allowing teams to focus on more strategic initiatives. By automating document creation, organizations can ensure that their processes are not only faster but also more reliable, making the docx skill a valuable addition to any AI automation toolkit.
Automatically generate client contracts based on predefined templates, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
Create personalized letters for mass mailings in seconds, enhancing communication efficiency.
Produce automated reports from various data sources, such as databases, to keep stakeholders informed.
Update and format existing documents with new data inputs, ensuring all documents are current and relevant.

sections.usage:
```
Create a new DOCX document with the following content: [CONTENT]. Use [STYLE] formatting for the headings and body text. Include a table with [TABLE_DATA] and apply [TABLE_STYLE] to it. Save the document as [FILE_NAME].
```
Copy

```
I've created a new DOCX document titled 'Q3 Sales Report.docx' with the following content:

**Q3 Sales Report**

This document outlines the sales performance for Q3 2023.

**Top Performers**

1. John Doe - $120,000
2. Jane Smith - $95,000
3. Alex Johnson - $88,000

**Sales by Region**

| Region      | Sales   |
|-------------|---------|
| North       | $300,000|
| South       | $250,000|
| East        | $200,000|
| West        | $180,000|

The document uses 'Heading 1' for the title, 'Heading 2' for sections, and 'Normal' style for body text. The table has been formatted with the 'Medium Style 2 - Accent 1' table style.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent

sections.usage_vi:
```
Tạo một tài liệu DOCX mới với nội dung sau: [CONTENT]. Sử dụng định dạng [STYLE] cho các tiêu đề (heading) và phần thân văn bản. Thêm một bảng với [TABLE_DATA] và áp dụng [TABLE_STYLE] cho bảng đó. Lưu tài liệu với tên [FILE_NAME].
```
Copy

```
Tối đã tạo một tài liệu DOCX mới có tiêu đề 'Q3 Sales Report.docx' với nội dung sau:

**Q3 Sales Report**

Tài liệu này tóm tắt hiệu suất doanh số bán hàng trong Quý 3 năm 2023.

**Top Performers**

1. John Doe - $120,000
2. Jane Smith - $95,000
3. Alex Johnson - $88,000

**Sales by Region**

| Region      | Sales   |
|-------------|---------|
| North       | $300,000|
| South       | $250,000|
| East        | $200,000|
| West        | $180,000|

Tài liệu này sử dụng kiểu 'Heading 1' cho tiêu đề chính, 'Heading 2' cho các mục con và kiểu 'Normal' cho phần thân văn bản. Bảng đã được định dạng bằng kiểu bảng 'Medium Style 2 - Accent 1'.
```
